import json,hashlib,pathlib
p='products/research/tender-continuity/raw-page1.json'
b=open(p,'rb').read()
d=json.loads(b)
out={'source':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
for r in d.get('releases',[]):
  if '07b83e' in r.get('ocid',''):
    t=r.get('tender',{})
    out['release_id']=r.get('id');out['ocid']=r.get('ocid');out['date']=r.get('date')
    out['buyer']=r.get('buyer');out['tender']=t
    out['parties']=[{'name':x.get('name'),'roles':x.get('roles')} for x in r.get('parties',[])]
q=pathlib.Path('products/services/tender-south-ayrshire/release-extract.json');q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
q.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
print(q.read_text()[:6000])
